title: bug: JetBrains prior-handoff header reads from/to/createdAt, but the daemon writes releasedBy/releasedAt/reason, so every handoff box in Task Detail shows only "#N"
description:
Found by hunt task-2597ac6f (architect-1dd28c7c, finding F4). It was held back only because it shares MoeJson.kt, Models.kt and MoeJsonTest.kt with task-37e03b91. The governor filed it at 15:47Z on 2026-11-03 and accepts the overlap (worktree mode, merge-tree squash). The citations were re-checked at 946358a8.

PROBLEM. Task Detail's "prior handoffs" header never shows who released the task, when, or why. Every box reads just "#1", "#2" and so on. The JetBrains model expects keys the daemon never writes. The unit-test fixture encodes the wrong shape, so the suite stays green against a payload no daemon sends.

EVIDENCE (HEAD 946358a8).
- **Daemon:**
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:553-571: HandoffNote is {whatIsDone, whatRemains, pitfalls?, openQuestions?, releasedBy?, releasedAt, reason?, diskState?};
  - tools/releaseTask.ts:150-156, 240-241 and 293-294 write it.
- **JetBrains:**
  - model/Models.kt:124-132: HandoffNote(from, to, createdAt, ...);
  - util/MoeJson.kt:512-528: parseHandoffs reads "from", "to" and "createdAt";
  - toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt:910-918: handoffBlocks builds the header from those three fields;
  - src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt:419-427: the priorHandoffs fixture uses from/to/createdAt.
- **Repro:** /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.wire.test.ts F3. A real release_task writes the handoff keys `reason, releasedAt, releasedBy, whatIsDone, whatRemains`, never from/to/createdAt (notes.md in the same folder).

FIX DIRECTION.
- Model and parse releasedBy, releasedAt and reason per schema.ts. Render the header as "#N released by <releasedBy> (<releasedAt>)", with the reason when one is present. A note missing them still renders "#N" without error.
- Fix the fixture to the daemon's shape, and add a case that fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again.
- **Out of scope:** the VS Code twin has the same shape bug (moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts:202-210 HandoffNote, and TaskDetailPanel.ts around 1225). JetBrains goes first; do not edit VS Code in this row.

PLACEMENT (no dependsOn edge).
- task-37e03b91 (HIGH) edits Models.kt (PlanStep amendments), MoeJson.kt (step parse around 594-605), TaskDetailDialog.kt (step rendering) and MoeJsonTest.kt. task-40813cc1 edits ProjectSettings and parseProjectSettings.
- Keep this row's edits inside HandoffNote, parseHandoffs and handoffBlocks, and in the existing priorHandoffs fixture and its test method.
- Rebase on the target tip before landing if either peer has landed.
- Gradle runs only through cmd.exe gradlew.bat under the jetbrains-gradle lease. Hold the lease only around each run.
definitionOfDone: The JetBrains parser reads releasedBy, releasedAt and reason (schema.ts HandoffNote). Task Detail's handoff header shows the releaser and the release time, plus the reason when present. A note without them still renders "#N" without error.

MoeJsonTest's priorHandoffs fixture uses the daemon's shape (releasedBy/releasedAt/reason), and a test fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again. `gradlew.bat test` passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease. moe-vscode is untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first: move the two JetBrains test files to the daemon's handoff shape. Use the Edit tool only (global rail). The test sources will not compile until step 2 renames the model fields, so do not run Gradle between steps 1 and 2.

MoeJsonTest.kt:
(a) In liveTaskJson()'s priorHandoffs entry (lines 418-428 at ef5c7101), replace the three lines
  "from": "worker-1",
  "to": "qa-1",
  "createdAt": "2026-09-11T10:09:00.000Z",
with
  "releasedBy": "worker-1",
  "releasedAt": "2026-09-11T10:09:00.000Z",
  "reason": "context budget",
Keep the four body fields as they are.
(b) In `live runtime data survives a legacy time budget payload` (:573), replace `assertEquals("qa-1", requireNotNull(task.priorHandoffs).single().to)` with a whole-note equality:
  assertEquals(com.moe.model.HandoffNote(releasedBy = "worker-1", releasedAt = "2026-09-11T10:09:00.000Z", reason = "context budget", whatIsDone = "parser", whatRemains = "review", pitfalls = "two call sites", openQuestions = "none"), requireNotNull(task.priorHandoffs).single())
Use the FULLY-QUALIFIED name, with no new import line. task-40813cc1 may add model imports in the same block, and two insertions at the same spot conflict in the merge-tree landing.
(c) Add a new @Test directly after that method, before `a malformed legacy time budget leaves unrelated error handling intact` (:581). Not near :360, where task-37e03b91 inserts its own test. Name it `prior handoffs read the daemon's releasedBy, releasedAt and reason, never from, to or createdAt`.
  - Its JSON is one task, `{"id": "task-h", "priorHandoffs": [ ... ]}`, with two notes.
  - Note 1: releasedBy "worker-1", releasedAt "2026-11-03T10:00:00.000Z", reason "context budget", whatIsDone "parser", whatRemains "ui", plus the decoys from "decoy-from", to "decoy-to", createdAt "decoy-created".
  - Note 2: legacy keys only: from "w1", to "w2", createdAt "2026-09-11T09:30:00Z", whatIsDone "legacy only", whatRemains "x".
  - Expected: listOf(com.moe.model.HandoffNote(releasedBy = "worker-1", releasedAt = "2026-11-03T10:00:00.000Z", reason = "context budget", whatIsDone = "parser", whatRemains = "ui"), com.moe.model.HandoffNote(whatIsDone = "legacy only", whatRemains = "x")).
  - Assert it equals BOTH parseTask(json).priorHandoffs and parseSnapshotTask(json).priorHandoffs. Both parser paths call parseHandoffs (MoeJson.kt:432 and :635).
  - Data-class equality is what makes this bite. Re-adding from/to/createdAt to the model (they would parse to the decoys) fails it, and so does sourcing releasedBy/releasedAt from from/createdAt. This is DoD 2's 'a test fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again'.

TaskTimingPresentationTest.kt (it asserts the old header and must move with it):
(d) :177, the rich fixture: `"\"priorHandoffs\":[{\"from\":\"w1\",\"to\":\"w2\"}]"` becomes the same with {"releasedBy":"w1","releasedAt":"2026-09-11T09:30:00Z"}.
(e) `each supplemental item on its own still yields a populated section` (:304-310): the note's from/to/createdAt become releasedBy "w1", releasedAt "2026-09-11T09:30:00Z", reason "context budget", with the body fields kept. The expected header becomes exactly "#1 released by w1 (2026-09-11T09:30:00Z): context budget".
(f) `handoffs keep their supplied order and number from one` (:329-335): the notes become [{"releasedBy":"a"},{"releasedAt":"ts"},{"reason":"why"},{},{"from":"x","to":"y","createdAt":"z"}]. The headers must be exactly ["#1 released by a", "#2 (ts)", "#3: why", "#4", "#5"]. The last two pin DoD 1's 'a note without them still renders #N without error', legacy keys included.
(g) `a fully populated task keeps every supplement alongside the KPIs` (:348 and :362): {"from":"w1"} becomes {"releasedBy":"w1"}, and the expected value becomes listOf("#1 released by w1").
implementationPlan.note: Updated daemon-shaped fixtures, whole-note equality and decoy regression through both parser paths; updated full/partial/empty/legacy-only header expectations. Gradle explicitly deferred per approved step until model rename in step 2.

Replaced nonexistent wire fields with releasedBy/releasedAt/reason and documented daemon schema. Reused getStringOrNull and independent isNullOrBlank guarded header fragments; no body or unrelated parsing changes. Fresh Gradle verification follows in the plan's dedicated gate.

implementationPlan.description:
Gate, run ONCE. Its output is moe.complete_task's verification evidence.
1. Take the shared lease: moe.acquire_resource { resourceId: "jetbrains-gradle", taskId, workerId, note: "gradlew test --rerun" } (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease). If it is queued, moe.report_blocked with that resourceId parks the task and the grant returns it.
2. Run the executionContract checkRef from inside your worktree. It does the following:
   - cds to <worktree>/moe-jetbrains (gradlew.bat lives there, not at the repo root; mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box 2c);
   - runs Windows `.\gradlew.bat test --rerun` through cmd.exe, because WSL has no JDK (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-from-wsl);
   - prints the BUILD line and the summed TEST-*.xml counts, and exits with Gradle's code.
   `--rerun` matters: a plain `test` can be UP-TO-DATE and run zero tests.
3. Release the lease right after, on failure too.

Expected: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0, and `xml tests=N skipped=S failures=0 errors=0`, where N is the target's baseline plus 1 (the new MoeJsonTest case). If the exit is red with a truncated tail, check the Gradle daemon log for the loopback IPC flake (same memory, trap 2) and re-run once before believing it.

Nothing outside moe-jetbrains changes, so run no npm or vitest. moe-vscode must stay untouched (DoD 2). Its twin bug, moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts:202-210, is out of scope.

On placement: get_context says isEpicFinal only through the highest-order fallback on this bucket epic. This plugin-wide suite IS the full regression for the only package touched; there is no cross-package flow to integrate.

Adversarial self-review (the one review step), then complete_task with step 3's evidence.
(1) Scope: `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` show exactly the 5 planned files. Nothing in MoeBundle.properties, moe-vscode or MoeJsonTest's import block, and no untracked file in the worktree.
(2) Leniency and error handling: the decoy test's legacy-only note and the `{}` and legacy rows in TaskTimingPresentationTest prove a note missing the daemon keys parses to nulls and renders "#N" without throwing. getStringOrNull and the non-object skip are unchanged.
(3) Mutation check. Make a scratch archive copy, never touching the worktree (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-qa-mutants-in-archive-copy):
   - `git archive HEAD moe-jetbrains | tar -x -C /mnt/d/moe-scratch/ac587df5-mut/repo`, then copy your 5 edited files over it (a scratch dir, so cp is fine there).
   - Under the jetbrains-gradle lease, run ONE mutant at a time with `.\gradlew.bat test --tests <Class> --rerun`. The --tests value is unquoted.
   - Required mutants:
     - M2: drop the reason append in handoffBlocks. com.moe.toolwindow.TaskTimingPresentationTest must fail.
     - M3: re-add `val from: String? = null` to HandoffNote and `from = h.getStringOrNull("from")` to parseHandoffs. com.moe.util.MoeJsonTest must fail on the new decoy test.
   - Optional M1: source releasedBy from "from" in parseHandoffs. MoeJsonTest must fail.
   - Restore each mutant and delete the scratch copy afterwards.
(4) Concurrency: the edits are pure parse and presentation with no shared state. If task-37e03b91 or task-40813cc1 lands first, landing is a merge-tree squash and these hunks are disjoint from theirs. Only if landing reports a conflict: rebase on the target tip and re-run the gate.
(5) Would I be embarrassed? The header must never show 'null' or a dangling ' released by ' or ' ()'. Each fragment is guarded by isNullOrBlank.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The JetBrains plugin models and parses a prior hand-off note the way the daemon writes it (releasedBy, releasedAt, reason; schema.ts HandoffNote). Task Detail's handoff box title reads '#N released by <releasedBy> (<releasedAt>): <reason>', each fragment shown only when present, so a note with none of them still reads '#N'. The never-written from/to/createdAt keys are gone from the model and parser. MoeJsonTest's fixture uses the daemon's shape, and a decoy test fails if the parser reads from/to/createdAt again. moe-vscode is untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Parsing a note with releasedBy/releasedAt/reason yields HandoffNote(releasedBy, releasedAt, reason, ...body) through both parseTask and the snapshot path. Legacy from/to/createdAt keys present in the same JSON are ignored: data-class equality with no extra fields.
handoffBlocks headers: full note '#1 released by w1 (2026-09-11T09:30:00Z): context budget'; partial notes '#1 released by a', '#2 (ts)', '#3: why'; empty note '#4'; legacy-only note '#5'.
`gradlew.bat test --rerun` (the checkRef) exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease with failures=0 errors=0 in the summed TEST-*.xml.
Mutants: removing the reason append fails TaskTimingPresentationTest; re-adding a parsed `from` field fails the MoeJsonTest decoy test.
git diff touches only the 5 planned moe-jetbrains files; moe-vscode is unchanged.
invariants: Parsing stays lenient. A missing, null or wrong-typed key becomes null; a non-object entry is skipped. Nothing throws on a malformed note.
The header never prints 'null' or an empty ' released by ', ' ()' or ': ' fragment: each fragment is guarded by isNullOrBlank.
Hunks stay inside HandoffNote, parseHandoffs, handoffBlocks and the named test fixtures and methods, disjoint from task-37e03b91 and task-40813cc1.
compatibility: Backward-compatible with existing .moe/ state: the daemon has written releasedBy/releasedAt/reason since HandoffNote was introduced (480dd8a9). All 18 handoff notes on the live board use those keys, and none use from/to/createdAt.
No daemon, MCP or wire change: the plugin only reads task.priorHandoffs.
TaskCard's handoff badge (TaskCard.kt:155) reads only priorHandoffs.size and is unaffected.
approvedScope: model/Models.kt HandoffNote: from/to/createdAt replaced by releasedBy/releasedAt/reason, plus a one-line KDoc.
toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt companion handoffBlocks: the header buildString only.
src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt: the liveTaskJson priorHandoffs entry, the :573 assertion, and one new test method after it.
src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/TaskTimingPresentationTest.kt: the handoff fixtures and header expectations at :177, :304-310, :329-335, :348 and :362.
reuse: The existing getStringOrNull helper and the existing header buildString pattern (independent guarded appends).
The existing parseTask / parseSnapshotTask test helpers (MoeJsonTest.kt:361-372) and TaskTimingPresentationTest's task(...) JSON builder.
sourceAssumptions: packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:553-571 HandoffNote = {whatIsDone, whatRemains, pitfalls?, openQuestions?, releasedBy?, releasedAt, reason?, diskState?}. releaseTask.ts:150-156 builds it, and :240-241/:293-294 set releasedBy and reason (reason sliced to 2000 chars).

moe-jetbrains model/Models.kt:124-132 HandoffNote(from, to, createdAt, whatIsDone, whatRemains, pitfalls, openQuestions). util/MoeJson.kt:512-528 parseHandoffs is called from :432 (snapshot parseTasks) and :635 (parseTask).
toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt:910-918 handoffBlocks builds HandoffBlock.header. metricsPresentation (:823) is internal and pure, and is tested headlessly by TaskTimingPresentationTest.

MoeJsonTest.kt:418-428 is the priorHandoffs entry inside liveTaskJson(), and :573 asserts `.to == "qa-1"`. TaskTimingPresentationTest.kt:177, 305-310, 329-335, 348 and 362 use from/to/createdAt fixtures and headers.
checkRefs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/moe-jetbrains" && L=$(mktemp) && cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $(wslpath -w "$PWD") && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun" > "$L" 2>&1; r=$?; grep -aE "BUILD (SUCCESSFUL|FAILED)| FAILED$" "$L"; grep -ho 'tests="[0-9]*" skipped="[0-9]*" failures="[0-9]*" errors="[0-9]*"' build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml | awk -F'"' '{t+=$2;s+=$4;f+=$6;e+=$8} END {print "xml tests="t" skipped="s" failures="f" errors="e}'; exit $r

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Keep from/to/createdAt beside the new fields as a fallback. Rejected: the daemon never wrote them, and keeping them invites exactly the regression DoD 2 forbids. (2) Put the reason in a body row (a new 'Reason' handoffBlock). Rejected: DoD 1 puts it in the header, it would need a MoeBundle key in a file task-37e03b91 holds, and it would add a 6th file. (3) Truncate or fold the reason in the header, or add a tooltip. Rejected (YAGNI): Swing's TitledBorder already clips its title at the panel width with '...', and 0 of the 18 live reasons contain line breaks. (4) A Gradle dry run during planning. Not done: this seat has no acquire_resource tool for the jetbrains-gradle lease. The edits are spelled out exactly instead, and the worker's gate plus the M2/M3 mutants are the proof.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: TaskDetailDialog's companion metricsPresentation/handoffBlocks is pure and headless (no bundle), tested by TaskTimingPresentationTest through a JSON task(...) builder. MoeJson has two parse paths (snapshot parseTasks :432, single parseTask :635) that share parseHandoffs; the existing tests assert they agree. getStringOrNull is lenient. The live board (.moe/tasks) has 14 tasks with 18 handoff notes, all keyed releasedBy/releasedAt/reason, with reasons of 18-586 chars. Peers in the same files (worktree mode): task-37e03b91 (REVIEW) edits Models.kt ~91-120, MoeJson.kt ~24 and ~604-630, TaskDetailDialog.kt ~452-467, MoeJsonTest.kt with an insert after :360, and MoeBundle.properties. task-40813cc1 (WORKING) edits ProjectSettings/parseProjectSettings and MoeJsonTest settings cases.
planningNotes.risks: Merge-tree conflicts with peers: keep the hunks where the steps say, use the FQN com.moe.model.HandoffNote in MoeJsonTest instead of an import, and put the new test after :579, not near :360. Gradle traps: gradlew.bat is in moe-jetbrains/ (not the root); `--rerun` is needed; an IPC flake can turn a good build red; WSL has no JDK, so use cmd.exe; mutants run in an archive copy, never in the worktree. The jetbrains-gradle lease is shared with peers' gates and QA, so release it promptly. Global rails: Edit/Write only for tracked files; no pattern-kill.
